items.title: Slide Hampton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Let’s see. I think he probably was. They still had all the writers and everything there.

ctx.x: I felt I needed the experience as a conductor. I needed that experience. So for that reason it was good. Then this time . . .
Was H. P. Barnum around any of this during that time?
Let’s see. I think he probably was. They still had all the writers and everything there.
